glass.label: VGlass
glass.description: Works only while [VGlass in Appearance > Windows](page:vgs.windows) is set to Each surface decides
glass.info: VGlass draws notifications as frosted glass with a moving edge light.

slackPhotos.label: Slack photos
slackPhotos.info: Shows the sender photo and workspace icon from Slack on a notification. Add a Slack token for each workspace under Slack tokens.

duration.label: Notification duration
duration.description: Urgent notifications stay until you close them, and a sender can ask for more time

slackTokens.label: Slack tokens
slackTokens.hint: Connect each workspace to show sender photos
slackTokens.info: Select [Set up Slack photos on the Details tab](page:vgs.notifications/Details) to create the Slack app. Then add its User OAuth Token for each workspace. VGS stores the token in your keyring.

notification.label: New notification
notification.description: Plays when a notification shows on screen. Sound off and Do Not Disturb also mute an app's own notification sound. Calls and media the app starts while either is on can be silent for up to 15 seconds.

binds.info: Opens the list of notifications you have not cleared, or closes it.
Does what a click on the newest notification does, also after it goes into the history.
Marks every notification as read, closes their popups and the panel, and keeps them in History.
